thesis:
哪些格子应该留空？面试没问出某项能力，不该填低分；代理没有近期令牌，不该填「业务已退役」。本期四组资料追到业务人员真正要落笔的地方：客户待办由谁批准，周报数字能否重算，面试引文支持什么判断，以及谁有权恢复被停用的账号。

会前简报和经营周报可以先留在草稿箱，错了再改；候选人被淘汰、结账代理被停用，错误却可能要到下一次面试或关账时才显现。四组材料共同提示一种试点做法：给每条建议保留原始记录，同时写明证据不足时谁能补证、谁有权执行、出错由谁恢复。把这些人的时间计入成本，再决定是否扩大自动化范围。
takeaways: Roeto 把写入客户档案留给顾问批准。试点应计时到顾问核验并签认为止；首轮推广到 800 家机构，不代表这些顾问都获得了案例估算的节时。
MM-ReportBench 抽检的同一份报告可以既报错数，又画错图。企业验收应分别核对原表、数字和图，再按报告去重统计返工，不能把两类错误率相加。
Connect Talent 的 89.3% 是对同一批面试文本中行为信号的判断一致率。让招聘人员回看引文有证据支持；将缺少回答直接记为不胜任，没有。
Entra 的公告和配置文档连默认停用日都不一致。治理团队应先验证租户里的通知、停用和恢复分别由谁接手；不能因为代理近期未取得令牌，就判它已无用途。
contrarian: 「让模型给每一项都打分，人工审核就会更快」并不总成立。AWS 披露的设计恰好为证据不足保留空项；报表评测也显示，完整得足以交稿的报告仍可能写错数字。编辑判断：如果审核人很难回到原始记录，补满分数会把查证变成纠错。若在同一批任务的盲测中，强制打分组既缩短含返工在内的审核时间，又不增加误淘汰或错报，这个判断就应修正。

items.title: 金融顾问的会前简报：能查客户资料，不等于能改客户记录
items.type: 具名客户部署案例＋服务方使用条款
items.source: 2026-11-19，实施方 Commit 发布 Roeto Teammate 案例；关联材料为 Roeto 隐私政策附录 A。

relatedLinks.label: Roeto：AI 助手的权限与核验责任（附录 A）

items.summary: 保险或财富顾问在会面前要弄清三件事：客户已经买了什么、哪些建议没有落实、今天还有什么值得问。以色列金融软件商 Roeto 把这项准备工作放回原有客户管理系统：顾问用自然语言点出客户，Teammate 汇拢档案、保单、组合和待办，标出可能遗漏的保障或值得复核的费用。实施方披露，顾问能据此接续安排跟进，而不必把对话结果抄回另一套系统。这个案例的看点不是助手能否代替顾问做投资选择，而是会前资料如何成为会后可执行、且仍由顾问批准的一条待办。
items.design: 据实施方说明，Claude 负责语言处理，专用代理通过 Bedrock AgentCore Gateway 连接已有业务工具；查询客户情况与更新客户档案属于两种不同操作。Roeto 的助手条款只允许授权企业用户访问原本有权查看的数据，且要求用户在依赖建议或执行前核验。建立任务、安排会议或改客户记录，需要顾问批准后才调用接口。项目以整理好的参考样例测试代理准确性，但未公开样例分布、检索排序、置信阈值或超时重试方式。编辑建议：写入超时先查原记录，确认为未执行后再重试，以免给客户安排两次同一会议。
items.evidence: 证据等级：B（具名实施方和客户条款可交叉核对）；效率数字为厂商自报。实施方称首轮推广覆盖 800 家金融机构，机构接入客户管理系统由约六周缩至两周；这是接入周期，不是单场会面的准备时间。另称每名顾问每日可省 43–120 分钟，属于估算；产能和生产率改善 30%–50% 属于预测。公开材料未给出活跃顾问人数、计时样本、观察期、对照组或人工改错成本。客户条款能佐证访问权限与核验责任，不能验证节省的时间，也没有独立效果测量。编辑判断：能开通不等于常用；应按每场最终获顾问签认的简报计算净耗时，保留退回和不用助手的会议作对照。
items.idea: 给一家顾问机构做只读试点：每场会前只列现有保单、未结事项和各自出处，不推荐产品，也不写客户档案。顾问逐条确认并登记遗漏，把核验与改稿时间算入成本。与同一顾问手工作业的相似会议比较总准备分钟数、关键事项漏列率和错引客户记录数；出现串户即暂停。

items.title: 经营周报的数字和图表，为什么要分开验收
items.type: 研究预印本｜表格生成报告的离线评测

relatedLinks.label: 全文：评分方法与错误分析

items.summary: 写经营周报时，最难发现的错往往不是漏了图，而是图和文字都像对的，数字却取自相邻一列。MM-ReportBench 把这道日常验收题拆开：用同一份源表分别检查报告里的论断、图上的取值，以及图能否支撑那句结论。作者不是请评审挑一份最好看的报告，而是为每个任务准备参考分析，再检查模型多写出的发现是否也能从原表推出。对已经能自动生成周报的团队，这提供了一个可复用的审稿办法：退回具体出错的数字或图，而不必让分析师重读整篇文字。
items.design: 输入是业务问题和一张或多张表。制作参考答案时，两名标注者从机器生成的候选报告中筛选、纠错，争议交资深专家裁定。评分时，文本评审把数字陈述改成核验问题，三个模型各自写查询、在源表计算，至少两个结果在百分之一容差内一致才算核实；图表评审从图中还原数值，与查询所得数据比对，并检查坐标和标签。这里输出的是分项分数，不是获准发送的周报。论文未规定企业账户权限、超时重试或发布审批；落地时可只读授权快照，查不到数据就保留草稿，由分析师按相同口径重算。
items.evidence: 证据等级：B（预印本，有人工抽验，未见外部复现）。可确认的研究设计是以185张真实表构造386项报告任务。作者比较20个模型，最高综合分为68.9分，满分100；这是加权评分，不是合格率。作者另从生成报告中随机抽200份，人工发现38.5%含凭空生成或取错的数值，22.0%有图与数据不符；同一份可有多种错，两项不能相加。另有六名业务分析师对分层抽取的100份报告评分，不是又发现100份错误。没有厂商上线指标，也无独立团队在真实周报中验证节省工时。编辑判断：公开表和模板化问题适合暴露错列等毛病，却没有覆盖企业内部经常变化的指标定义，不能据此预估自己公司的返工率。
items.idea: 让经营分析组只选一份每周重做的渠道销售表，以冻结快照生成一页草稿。把每个同比数字和每张图对应的列、日期范围交给复核人，特别保留退货冲销和分母为零的历史样本。与现有人工流程并行，记录每百条数值陈述的漏错数、被误退的正确图表数和每份审稿分钟数；试验期间不自动发报。

items.title: AI 面试没问出证据时，分数应当留空
items.type: 厂商工程披露／受托专家评估／候选人操作指南
items.source: 2026-11-19，AWS 机器学习博客；产品已于 2026-09-16 正式可用

relatedLinks.label: 候选人退出与故障处理

items.summary: 如果求职者说自己解决过客户投诉，却没有说明亲自做了什么，面试员该追问，还是直接扣分？亚马逊披露了其招聘产品处理这类缺口的方法：对话只负责收集行为证据，评分在面试结束后另行处理。团队看到的不只是一个总分，而是某项能力是否有材料支持、依据是哪句原话。这次新增的是评估方法和结果披露，不是产品首次上线。对批量招聘负责人而言，最有用的区别是：没有问出证据与发现不合岗位要求的行为，是两种不同的结果，不应流入同一个淘汰队列。
items.design: 系统将岗位要求和职业框架转成能力项、行为评分表与面试问题，招聘团队可以在使用前修改。求职者通过邀请链接进入，可在语音环节开始前拒绝该环节，申请仍然有效。对话模型按回答追问；之后另一个评估环节从转录文本标出支持行为的原句，不用声音语调、影像或身份信息计分。证据充足的能力项按固定公式得一至五分，不足则标记，不用低分补空。招聘人员查看材料、作最终决定。技术故障由招聘方重发邀请；已完成的测验保留，中断的面试须重做。
items.evidence: 证据等级：B（厂商披露的受托专家对照）。亚马逊称，外部工业与组织心理学机构审阅了三十六场面试，得到二百五十二个行为信号；在同一批文本上，系统与专家判断的一致率为89.3%，校正偶然一致后的κ值为0.79。分母是信号而非求职人数；同一场面试贡献多个判断，也不能把专家意见当成未来工作表现。公开价是每份完成的面试加测验组合评估二十美元，不是成功招聘一人的成本。未见独立团队复现这些产品数字，也未见按岗位、辅助技术使用情况分组的误差或入职后随访。编辑判断：这支持试验逐条核对引用，不足以证明自动淘汰能提高录用质量。
items.idea: 招聘运营团队可先用经授权的历史转录稿做影子测试，仅核对一个岗位的一项能力，不输出录用建议。两位面试官在看不到机器结果时分别标注原句，再核对分歧；记录引文确实支持该行为的比例、把证据不足误写为负面的次数，以及人工完成一次复核所需的分钟数。

items.title: 闲置代理何时停用？微软公告与配置文档给出了不同的时钟
items.type: 产品公告 × 身份治理配置文档
items.source: 2026-11-17，Microsoft Entra；关联两份 Microsoft Learn 文档分别更新于 10-28、10-09

relatedLinks.label: 默认闲置策略与时间表
生命周期规则与执行顺序

items.summary: 季度结账代理可能几个月不用，但到了关账日仍得正常签入。反过来，一个被业务废弃的代理，即使已经没人维护，也可能保有访问权限。微软在 Ignite 宣布，Entra 的代理身份生命周期管理已正式可用：管理员可以按闲置情况、责任人是否齐全、业务方是否仍确认需要这项服务来处置身份。难点是把需要调查的账号与可以停用的账号分开。尤其值得注意的是，发布公告和默认策略文档对何时停用的表述不同，照着新闻中的一个天数写生产变更单，可能连应当测试哪个动作都选错。
items.design: 规则面向纳入策略的代理身份。按配置文档，闲置看的是一段时间内有没有签发令牌，并不读取工作成果，也不需要模型推断其价值。管理员启用策略、界定范围；若范围重叠，匹配的高优先级策略生效。规则可向业务责任人或所有者发通知；两者都不存在时，可通知管理员预设的后备收件人。季节性任务可设为例外。对于默认策略，已停用或删除的身份不能靠责任人收到通知就恢复，须由所有者或管理员处理。文档没有给出通知投递失败后的统一兜底时限，应在测试租户演练收件人失联和恢复。
items.evidence: 证据等级：B（两份厂商配置文档与正式公告；没有独立生产验证）。可确认的是，11 月 17 日公告将此能力列为正式可用，并概括为预置策略会停用闲置满 60 天的身份；10 月 28 日更新、仍标为预览的默认策略文档却把三个动作分列为闲置满 60 天通知、90 天停用、455 天删除，且须启用策略。两者时间和措辞不同，不能据此断言任一租户的实际执行日，也不能把天数当成减少风险的成效。微软未给出租户样本、误停率、恢复用时或实施前后对照。编辑判断是，未签发令牌能帮助找出待核实身份，却不能证明业务不再需要它；季度结账与应急备用代理尤其需要另核业务日历。
items.idea: 给身份治理与财务运营团队做一张只读的闲置代理复核单，只覆盖一个结账流程，把令牌记录、下次计划运行时间、所有者与后备收件人并排展示。由流程负责人逐条标记保留或退役，不执行停用；记录候选中仍有明确用途的比例、联系到责任人的用时，以及测试身份恢复是否成功。

projectIdeas.title: 会前简报的净节时试验
projectIdeas.description: 给一家顾问机构做单客户、只读的会前简报。每条待办附档案出处，由顾问勾选、更正或退回；与同一顾问手工准备的相近会议比较端到端用时、漏项和串户数，不以生成时间代替节时。

projectIdeas.title: 结账代理的停用演练
projectIdeas.description: 给财务系统所有者和身份管理员做测试租户演练，只用一个模拟季末结账身份。负责人确认业务日历，管理员记录实际通知、停用、恢复时点；验收看能否找对恢复人、恢复耗时、是否错过下一次模拟关账。

en.thesis:
Which fields should stay blank? An interview that yields no evidence of a competency does not justify a low score; no recent token does not mean a business service is retired. Four sources follow decisions to the person who must actually make them: approving a client task, recalculating a report figure, assessing what an interview quote supports, and restoring a disabled account.

Meeting briefs and management reports can stay in draft and be corrected. A rejected applicant or disabled quarter-end agent may not reveal the error until the next interview or close. In a pilot, keep the original record with each suggestion and specify who can supply missing evidence, authorize action and restore service. Count their time before expanding automation.
takeaways: Roeto leaves writes to client records subject to adviser approval. Measure through verification and sign-off: an initial rollout to 800 agencies does not show that their advisers achieved the estimated time savings.

The same report in MM-ReportBench’s sample could contain both a wrong figure and a wrong chart. Check the table, figure and chart separately, then deduplicate by report to measure rework. Do not add the two error rates.
Connect Talent’s 89.3% is agreement on behavioral signals in the same interview transcripts. It supports reviewing the cited passage, not treating missing answers as evidence of incompetence.

Entra’s announcement and configuration guide disagree even on the default disablement day. Test who handles notification, disablement and recovery in the tenant; a lack of recently issued tokens does not establish that an agent has no business purpose.
en.contrarian: Making the model score every field will not always speed review. AWS explicitly leaves a competency unscored when evidence is missing; the report benchmark found wrong numbers in apparently finished reports. Our judgment: when reviewers cannot easily get to the original record, filling every field turns verification into correction. Revise that judgment if a blinded comparison on the same tasks finds that mandatory scoring reduces total review time, including rework, without increasing wrongful exclusions or misreporting.

items.title: A financial adviser’s meeting brief: permission to read is not permission to write
items.type: Named customer deployment and operator’s terms
items.source: Nov 19, 2026: implementer Commit’s Roeto Teammate case study; related material: Appendix A of Roeto’s privacy policy.

relatedLinks.label: Roeto: assistant permissions and verification responsibilities (Appendix A)

items.summary: Before a meeting, insurance and wealth advisers need to know what the client already holds, which recommendations remain open and what is worth asking today. Israeli software provider Roeto brought this preparation into its existing CRM. An adviser names the client in natural language; Teammate gathers the profile, policies, portfolio and outstanding tasks and flags potential coverage gaps or fees worth checking. The implementer says the adviser can then arrange follow-up without copying the conversation into another system. The useful change is not delegating investment decisions: it is turning meeting preparation into a follow-up task that still requires the adviser's approval.
items.design: According to Commit, Claude handles language processing and specialized agents connect to existing business tools via Bedrock AgentCore Gateway. Looking up a client and editing the client's record are separate operations. Roeto’s terms limit the assistant to authorized business users and their existing data access, and require users to verify outputs before relying on or acting on them. Creating a task, scheduling a meeting or changing a customer record requires adviser approval before the API call. The project uses curated reference cases to test accuracy but does not disclose the case mix, retrieval ranking, confidence thresholds or timeout and retry policy. Editorial recommendation: after a write times out, inspect the record and retry only if the original action did not go through, to avoid booking the meeting twice.
items.evidence: Evidence grade: B for the named implementer account cross-checked against the customer’s terms; efficiency figures are supplier-reported. Commit says the first rollout covered 800 financial agencies and CRM onboarding fell from about six weeks to two. That is the time to onboard an agency, not to prepare for a meeting. Savings of 43–120 minutes per adviser per day are estimates; gains of 30%–50% in capacity and productivity are projections. The materials do not provide active adviser counts, a timed sample, observation period, control group or cost of human corrections. The terms corroborate access and verification responsibilities, not time savings; there is no independent outcome measurement here. Editorial judgment: receiving access is not repeated use. Measure net preparation time per signed-off brief and retain rejected briefs and meetings without the assistant for comparison.
items.idea: Pilot a read-only brief at one advisory firm. List only existing policies, open items and their sources; recommend no products and make no CRM changes. Advisers verify each entry and log omissions. Include checking and editing in the cost. Compare total minutes, missed key items and wrong-client citations against similar meetings prepared manually by the same adviser. Pause if any data crosses between clients.

items.title: Why the figures and charts in a weekly operating report need separate checks
items.type: Research preprint | Offline evaluation of table-to-report generation
items.source: 2026-11-17 | Teng Lin and Nan Tang, arXiv (MM-ReportBench v1)

relatedLinks.label: Full text: scoring methods and error analysis

items.summary: A missing chart is easier to spot than a polished chart and sentence that both use a value from the next column. MM-ReportBench breaks that acceptance test apart: check the claims, plotted values and whether the chart supports the conclusion against the same source table. Instead of choosing whichever report looks best, the authors prepare a reference analysis for each task and assess whether any additional discoveries also follow from the data. For teams already generating weekly reports, the useful idea is to return the specific figure or chart that failed, without making an analyst reread all the prose.
items.design: The inputs are a business question and one or more tables. Two annotators select and correct machine-generated candidate reference reports; a senior expert resolves disagreements. At evaluation time, the text judge turns numerical statements into verification questions. Three models independently write queries and compute answers from the source tables; at least two results must agree within a 1% tolerance for verification. The chart judge extracts values from the chart, compares them with query results and checks axes and labels. The output is a set of scores, not clearance to send a report. The paper specifies no enterprise permissions, timeout recovery or publication approval. A local implementation could use a read-only authorized snapshot and leave the report in draft for analyst recalculation if the data cannot be retrieved.
items.evidence: Evidence grade B: preprint, human spot checks, no independent replication identified. The documented design comprises 386 reporting tasks based on 185 real tables. The authors compared 20 models; the best overall score was 68.9 out of 100, a weighted score rather than a pass rate. In a separate random sample of 200 generated reports, reviewers found invented or incorrect numbers in 38.5% and chart–data mismatches in 22.0%. Reports may have both, so the percentages cannot be added. Six business analysts also rated a stratified sample of 100 reports; these were not 100 further errors. There is no vendor deployment metric or independent field validation of labor savings. Editorial judgment: public tables and templated questions can surface column mix-ups, but do not cover changing internal metric definitions or predict a company's rework rate.
items.idea: Have the operating analytics team generate a one-page draft from a frozen snapshot of one weekly channel-sales table. Give the reviewer the columns and date windows behind every year-over-year figure and chart. Retain historical examples with returns or zero denominators. Run alongside the manual process and measure missed errors per hundred numerical claims, correct charts mistakenly rejected and review minutes per report. Do not distribute automatically during the pilot.

items.title: Leave the score blank when an AI interview fails to elicit evidence
items.type: Vendor engineering disclosure / commissioned expert evaluation / candidate guide
items.source: AWS Machine Learning Blog, November 19, 2026; generally available since September 16, 2026
items.summary: If a candidate says they resolved a customer complaint but does not explain what they personally did, should the interviewer probe or mark them down? Amazon describes how its hiring product handles that gap: the conversation collects behavioral evidence, and scoring happens separately after the interview. Reviewers see whether the record supports a particular competency and which passage supports it. What is new is the publication of evaluation methods and results, not the product launch. For high-volume hiring, failing to elicit evidence and observing behavior that falls short of a job requirement are different outcomes. They should not feed the same rejection queue.
items.design: Job requirements and occupational frameworks yield competencies, behavioral scorecards and interview questions that hiring teams can edit before use. Applicants enter via an invitation link and may decline the voice interview before it starts without deactivating the application. The conversational model asks follow-up questions. A separate evaluation identifies supporting transcript passages and excludes voice tone, video and identity information from scoring. A fixed formula assigns one to five points where evidence is sufficient; otherwise the competency is flagged rather than assigned a low score. Recruiters inspect the material and make the final decision. After technical trouble, a recruiter can resend the invitation: completed assessments are kept, but an interrupted interview must restart.
items.evidence: Evidence grade: B (vendor-reported comparison with commissioned experts). Amazon says an external industrial-organizational psychology firm reviewed 36 interviews yielding 252 behavioral signals. On the same transcripts, agreement with expert judgments was 89.3%, with a chance-corrected kappa of 0.79. The denominator is signals, not applicants; one interview contributes multiple judgments, and expert opinion is not later job performance. The list price is $20 per completed combined interview and assessment, not per successful hire. We found no independent replication of these product figures, error breakdown by role or assistive technology use, or follow-up on employee performance. Editorial judgment: the evidence warrants testing passage-by-passage verification, not claiming that automatic rejection improves hiring quality.
items.idea: Recruiting operations could shadow-test authorized historical transcripts on one competency for one role, producing no hiring recommendation. Two interviewers independently mark supporting passages without seeing model output, then resolve disagreements. Track the fraction of citations that support the behavior, cases where insufficient evidence was recorded as negative, and minutes of human review per case.

items.title: When does an idle agent get disabled? Microsoft's announcement and configuration guide give different timelines
items.source: November 17, 2026, Microsoft Entra; related Microsoft Learn guides updated October 28 and October 9
items.summary: A quarter-close agent can sit idle for months and still need to sign in on closing day. Conversely, an abandoned agent may retain access long after the business stops maintaining it. At Ignite, Microsoft announced general availability of Entra's automated lifecycle management for agent identities. Administrators can evaluate inactivity, whether an agent has sponsors, and whether someone has reconfirmed its business need. The hard part is distinguishing accounts that need investigation from those that can be disabled. The announcement and the default policy guide describe the disablement date differently: a production change request based on a single headline number could even test the wrong action.
items.design: Rules apply to agent identities within the policy scope. The guide measures inactivity by the absence of issued tokens over a period; the rule neither reads work products nor needs a model to estimate their value. An administrator enables the policy and sets its scope. If policies overlap, the highest-priority matching policy applies. Rules can notify sponsors or owners, or a configured fallback recipient if neither exists. Seasonal identities can be excluded. Under the documented default policy, receiving a notification does not give a sponsor authority to restore a disabled or deleted identity: an owner or administrator must act. The guide gives no universal fallback deadline for failed delivery. Test an unreachable recipient and the restoration path in a test tenant.
items.evidence: Evidence grade: B (two vendor configuration guides and a formal announcement; no independent production validation). The November 17 announcement calls the capability generally available and summarizes the built-in policy as disabling identities after 60 days of inactivity. The default policy guide, updated October 28 and still labeled preview, instead requires policy enablement and distinguishes notification at 60 days, disablement at 90 and deletion at 455. Those dated sources do not establish precisely when a particular tenant will enforce an action. Nor are the thresholds evidence of risk reduction. Microsoft reports no tenant sample, false-disablement rate, time to recover or before-and-after comparison. Our interpretation: absence of token issuance identifies an account worth reviewing, not a business need that has disappeared. Check the business calendar for quarter-close and emergency standby agents.
items.idea: For identity governance and finance operations, build a read-only review sheet for one close process. Show token history, next scheduled use, owner and fallback recipient together. The process owner labels each candidate for retention or retirement; the sheet disables nothing. Measure the share with a verified continuing purpose, time to reach the accountable person and whether a test identity can be recovered.

projectIdeas.title: Measure net meeting-preparation time
projectIdeas.description: For one advisory firm, generate a read-only brief for one client at a time. Attach a source to every proposed task and let the adviser confirm, correct or return it. Compare end-to-end minutes, omissions and cross-client errors with similar manually prepared meetings by the same adviser, not with generation time alone.

projectIdeas.title: Rehearse disabling a close agent
projectIdeas.description: Have the finance system owner and identity administrator use one simulated quarter-end identity in a test tenant. The owner confirms the business calendar; the administrator logs actual notification, disablement and restoration times. Check whether the right recovery owner was found, elapsed recovery time and whether the next simulated close was missed.
